name: TuriX CUA
description: Desktop computer-use agent that performs tasks on macOS, with Windows and Linux branches, using separate brain, actor and memory models.
whatItDoes: Takes a task written in a config file and carries it out by operating the real desktop. It is aimed at users and developers who want a locally run computer-use agent with swappable models.
howItWorks: The task and the model endpoints for each role are set in a JSON config file. A brain model reasons about the screen, an actor model produces concrete input actions, a memory model keeps context, and an optional planner breaks down long tasks. The main branch targets macOS 15 or later; other platforms live on dedicated branches.

requirements.name: macOS 15+
requirements.description: Main branch platform; other branches cover Windows and Linux

requirements.name: Model API key
requirements.description: Keys and base URLs for the configured roles, or a local Ollama setup

models: TuriX models, or other providers and Ollama per role
